context.person: A person using an online tax filing service
context.user_goal: Wait for final status before attempting another payment.

product_state.preceding_state: A bank payment was submitted, but the revenue agency has not returned a confirmation number.
product_state.current_state: The filing was submitted. The payment request was sent once.
known_facts: The payment request was sent once.
The bank outcome is not confirmed.
A final status will appear within two business days.

current_content.heading: Still working
current_content.body: We're working on it. Check again later.

challenge: Rewrite the in-product status card so the person can understand tax payment confirmation pending, the material consequence, and the available next action or recovery without unsupported claims.

constraints.character_counting_rule: Count spaces, numbers, and punctuation as characters.

interaction_contract.primary_action: View the filing and payment status.
interaction_contract.secondary_action: Contact support after two business days if no final status appears.
interaction_contract.consequence_to_preserve: A second payment could duplicate the tax payment while the outcome is unknown.
interaction_contract.recovery_to_preserve: Wait for final status before attempting another payment.

rationale_requirements: Explain how the wording represents the established product state without adding facts.
Explain how the material consequence and recovery remain visible.
Explain how each action or instruction matches its documented effect.
Report the character count for every candidate field.
Name unresolved questions instead of inventing policy, timing, certainty, or reassurance.
